If you’re looking for the current time in New York City, you can:

* Check the clock on your device and adjust for the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 in standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).  
* Use a quick web search or a world‑clock widget; most browsers and operating systems will display the correct local time automatically.

If you’d like me to explain how daylight‑saving changes the offset or help you set up a reliable time‑keeping method, just let me know!
